description: This file contains Python test classes and methods for testing systemd functionality in an embedded Linux environment, including systemctl commands, journalctl logs, and service management.

classes.name: SystemdTest
classes.description: Base class providing methods to interact with systemd via systemctl and journalctl.

classes.name: SystemdBasicTests
classes.description: Contains basic systemd tests such as checking systemd version and system state.

classes.name: SystemdServiceTests
classes.description: Tests for systemd service management including start, stop, enable, disable.

classes.name: SystemdJournalTests
classes.description: Tests related to journalctl logs and boot time analysis.

methods.name: systemctl
methods.description: Executes systemctl commands on the target system and checks the status.

methods.name: journalctl
methods.description: Retrieves journal logs from the target system, with optional filtering.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Waits until systemd has finished activating units or times out.

methods.name: test_systemd_failed
methods.description: Verifies that no systemd units have failed.

methods.name: test_systemd_status
methods.description: Checks the status of a specific systemd service.

methods.name: test_systemd_stop_start
methods.description: Stops and starts a systemd service, verifying its active state.

methods.name: test_systemd_disable_enable
methods.description: Disables and enables a systemd service.

methods.name: test_systemd_disable_enable_ro
methods.description: Remounts root as writable, disables/enables service, then remounts as read-only.

methods.name: test_systemd_boot_time
methods.description: Analyzes system boot time from journal logs and compares against timeout.
